keyShapeNote: This manifest keys scenarios on `scenarioId`, matching all ten pre-existing manifests in this repository. That choice is measured, not stylistic. Gate G057's counter in .github/bubbles/scripts/guards/control-plane-checks.sh line 132 counts occurrences of the literal key `"scenarioId"`, while scenario-state-resolve.sh (the Check 4 completion basis) keys on `"id"`. The two checks therefore require DIFFERENT field names, and a manifest satisfying one fails the other. Verified empirically on 2026-08-19 in an isolated worktree: an `id`-keyed manifest was counted as `only tracks 0 scenarios` by G057 AND flipped Check 4 onto the receipt basis, where it failed with `Required scenario states are NOT receipt-derived`, taking total guard failures from 2 to 6. The receipt basis is unreachable for ANY spec in this repository today: .specify/runtime/tool-calls.jsonl carries 1161 entries and ZERO scenarioBinding entries, and spec 017 is certified `done` while its own manifest scenarios resolve as `<unnamed>` / UNSATISFIED. Migrating this repository onto the receipt basis is a repository-wide decision affecting all specs, not something Feature 026 can adopt unilaterally. Recorded as finding R-24.
